question_text: George Washington is famous for many things. Name one.

official_answers.text: First president of the United States

why_it_matters.text: George Washington led the Continental Army through 8 years of war, presided over the Constitutional Convention, then became the first President. He set the precedents every president has followed since — including stepping down after 2 terms when he could have stayed in power. He's called the Father of Our Country.

fun_fact.text: In 1782, an army officer wrote George Washington suggesting he become King of the new country. Washington wrote back instantly, saying he viewed the idea 'with abhorrence' — that no event in the entire war had given him 'more painful sensations.' The man who could have been America's king chose to become its citizen instead.
